verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt on NVIDIA's developer portal (HTTP 200), and some pages are served as agent-friendly markdown (ai-models.md, hpc-sdk.md), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs for the ecosystem the H200 runs in. Coverage is uneven, though: cuda-toolkit.md returns 404, and the llms.txt is a portal-wide index rather than H200-specific. Missing for 10: H200-specific llms.txt or markdown docs, consistent .md coverage across key pages such as the CUDA Toolkit, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent usability.
